record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came again unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, set<WH07760><WTH8798> thy face<WH06440> against the Ammonites<WH01121><WH05983>, and prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734> against them;

And say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto the Ammonites<WH01121><WH05983>, Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the word<WH01697> of the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because thou saidst<WH0559><WTH8800>, Aha<WH01889>, against my sanctuary<WH04720>, when it was profaned<WH02490><WTH8738>; and against the land<WH0127> of Israel<WH03478>, when it was desolate<WH08074><WTH8738>; and against the house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063>, when they went<WH01980><WTH8804> into captivity<WH01473>;

Behold, therefore I will deliver<WH05414><WTH8802> thee to the men<WH01121> of the east<WH06924> for a possession<WH04181>, and they shall set<WH03427><WTH8765> their palaces<WH02918> in thee, and make<WH05414><WTH8804> their dwellings<WH04908> in thee: they shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> thy fruit<WH06529>, and they shall drink<WH08354><WTH8799> thy milk<WH02461>. <RF>men: Heb. children<Rf>

And I will make<WH05414><WTH8804> Rabbah<WH07237> a stable<WH05116> for camels<WH01581>, and the Ammonites<WH01121><WH05983> a couchingplace<WH04769> for flocks<WH06629>: and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because thou hast clapped<WH04222><WTH8763> <FI>thine<Fi> hands<WH03027>, and stamped<WH07554><WTH8800> with the feet<WH07272>, and rejoiced<WH08055><WTH8799> in heart<WH05315> with all thy despite<WH07589> against the land<WH0127> of Israel<WH03478>; <RF>hands: Heb. hand<Rf> <RF>feet: Heb. foot<Rf> <RF>heart: Heb. soul<Rf>

Behold, therefore I will stretch out<WH05186><WTH8804> mine hand<WH03027> upon thee, and will deliver<WH05414><WTH8804> thee for a spoil<WH0957><WTH8675><WH0897> to the heathen<WH01471>; and I will cut thee off<WH03772><WTH8689> from the people<WH05971>, and I will cause thee to perish<WH06><WTH8689> out of the countries<WH0776>: I will destroy<WH08045><WTH8686> thee; and thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>a spoil: or, meat<Rf><CM>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because<WH03282> that Moab<WH04124> and Seir<WH08165> do say<WH0559><WTH8800>, Behold, the house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063> <FI>is<Fi> like unto all the heathen<WH01471>;

Therefore, behold, I will open<WH06605><WTH8802> the side<WH03802> of Moab<WH04124> from the cities<WH05892>, from his cities<WH05892> <FI>which are<Fi> on his frontiers<WH07097>, the glory<WH06643> of the country<WH0776>, Bethjeshimoth<WH01020>, Baalmeon<WH01186>, and Kiriathaim<WH07156>, <RF>side...: Heb. shoulder of Moab<Rf>

Unto the men<WH01121> of the east<WH06924> with the Ammonites<WH01121><WH05983>, and will give<WH05414><WTH8804> them in possession<WH04181>, that the Ammonites<WH01121><WH05983> may not be remembered<WH02142><WTH8735> among the nations<WH01471>. <RF>with...: or, against the children of Ammon<Rf>
And I will execute<WH06213><WTH8799> judgments<WH08201> upon Moab<WH04124>; and they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because that Edom<WH0123> hath dealt<WH06213><WTH8800> against the house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063> by taking<WH05358><WTH8800> vengeance<WH05359>, and hath greatly<WH0816><WTH8800> offended<WH0816><WTH8799>, and revenged<WH05358><WTH8738> himself upon them; <RF>by...: Heb. by revenging revengement<Rf>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; I will also stretch out<WH05186><WTH8804> mine hand<WH03027> upon Edom<WH0123>, and will cut off<WH03772><WTH8689> man<WH0120> and beast<WH0929> from it; and I will make<WH05414><WTH8804> it desolate<WH02723> from Teman<WH08487>; and they of Dedan<WH01719> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>. <RF>they...: or, they shall fall by the sword unto Dedan<Rf>

And I will lay<WH05414><WTH8804> my vengeance<WH05360> upon Edom<WH0123> by the hand<WH03027> of my people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>: and they shall do<WH06213><WTH8804> in Edom<WH0123> according to mine anger<WH0639> and according to my fury<WH02534>; and they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> my vengeance<WH05360>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because the Philistines<WH06430> have dealt<WH06213><WTH8800> by revenge<WH05360>, and have taken<WH05358><WTH8735> vengeance<WH05359> with a despiteful<WH07589> heart<WH05315>, to destroy<WH04889> <FI>it<Fi> for the old<WH05769> hatred<WH0342>; <RF>for the...: or, with perpetual hatred<Rf>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, I will stretch out<WH05186><WTH8802> mine hand<WH03027> upon the Philistines<WH06430>, and I will cut off<WH03772><WTH8689> the Cherethims<WH03774>, and destroy<WH06><WTH8689> the remnant<WH07611> of the sea<WH03220> coast<WH02348>. <RF>sea coast: or, haven of the sea<Rf>

And I will execute<WH06213><WTH8804> great<WH01419> vengeance<WH05360> upon them with furious<WH02534> rebukes<WH08433>; and they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, when I shall lay<WH05414><WTH8800> my vengeance<WH05360> upon them. <RF>great vengeance: Heb. great vengeances<Rf><CM>
